# Archmatter

> A BIM tool for architects built for sketching, not configuring. Shape geometry first, add parameters when you're ready. Web-based, no installation.

Archmatter is a browser-based modeling tool for architects, currently in early access. The public site is a single landing page with product positioning and an email waitlist.

## Primary URL

- https://archmatter.io/

## Key messages

- Headline: Between the idea and the line
- Category: BIM / architectural modeling in the browser
- Differentiator: Built for sketching, not configuring — shape geometry first, add parameters when ready

## Contact / signup

- Early access waitlist via the email form on https://archmatter.io/

## Crawling

- Sitemap: https://archmatter.io/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://archmatter.io/robots.txt (allows all crawlers)
